title: 泥孩子谜题的历史
summary: 本文追溯了泥孩子谜题在过去两个世纪中的起源，该谜题对认知逻辑的发展具有启发意义。文章还介绍了其众多变体，并提出了一个涉及自指的新型帽子谜题。
summary_en: This paper traces the origin of the Muddy Children Puzzle over the past two centuries, which has inspired the development of epistemic logic. It also presents numerous variations and a novel hats puzzle involving self-reference.
